verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a 'Hybrid Deployment' model where an agent runs inside the customer's own environment for data processing, but this is explicitly one of two deployment options alongside SaaS, and the control plane/dashboard/orchestration remain Fivetran-hosted — not a full self-host of the core product. Missing for 10: evidence of the entire platform (control plane, UI, connector orchestration) being deployable outside Fivetran's cloud, or an open-source/downloadable core product.
